stageB.acceptance: Pre-repair evidence. Candidate generation success is not layout PASS; desired assertions may and should FAIL on current defects.

splitEvidenceContract.firefoxWebkitContentReachability: touch-capable layout plus trusted real mouse wheel; nativeTouchPan:false
splitEvidenceContract.firefoxWebkitAppSwipe: manual pointer/touch event; trusted:false; app handler only
splitEvidenceContract.claimBoundary: Firefox/WebKit results do not certify native touch-pan or physical Safari/iPad behavior.

limitations: WebKit is browser emulation, not physical iPhone/iPad Safari evidence.

Playwright touchscreen exposes trusted tap only. Under the explicitly approved split evidence contract, Chromium swipe uses trusted CDP touch input; Firefox/WebKit app swipe uses manual events with isTrusted=false, while content reachability uses real wheel on a touch-capable layout and records nativeTouchPan:false.
Software keyboards, hardware safe areas, browser zoom and OS font scaling remain NOT_RUN unless separately measured.
A missing required browser or capability makes Full nonzero and cannot be reclassified optional after execution.

stageC.acceptance: Stage C local Chromium scopes pass; three-engine Full/repeat manifest and discovery are implemented, but execution remains NOT_RUN until Firefox/WebKit are explicitly authorized and available. This is not real-device acceptance.
